meta.title: Valorant to Apex Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert Valorant sensitivity to Apex Legends. Precise cm/360 calculation.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Valorant sensitivity. The converter adjusts for Apex Legends' higher default FOV and different game engine.
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_2Desc: The Apex sensitivity value adjusts for FOV scaling and engine differences. Both hipfire and ADS sensitivities are calculated.
steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Apex Legends. Test in the Firing Range with different weapons — tracking aim is more important in Apex than in Valorant.
desc: Convert Valorant sensitivity to Apex Legends. Precise cm/360 calculation.
